paper.title_en: Prospects for Studying Hidden-Charm Pentaquark States with the ATLAS Detector
paper.abstract_en: Pentaquark states with hidden charm were discovered by the LHCb collaboration as a result of the analysis of $\Lambda _{b}^{0} \to J{\kern 1pt} /{\kern 1pt} \psi p{{K}^{ - }}$ decays in $pp$ collision data with a center-of-mass energy of $\sqrt s = 7,8$ TeV. The study of the spectrum of these states was subsequently conducted both by the LHCb experiment using $pp$ collision data with $\sqrt s = 13$ TeV and by the ATLAS experiment using $pp$ collision data with $\sqrt s = 7,8$ TeV. Current and future studies of $\Lambda _{b}^{0} \to J{\kern 1pt} /{\kern 1pt} \psi p{{K}^{ - }}$ decays are aimed at further investigation of the properties of the narrow resonances ${{P}_{{c\bar {c}}}}{{(4312)}^{ + }}$, ${{P}_{{c\bar {c}}}}{{(4440)}^{ + }}$, ${{P}_{{c\bar {c}}}}{{(4457)}^{ + }}$. At the same time, the existence of the broad resonance ${{P}_{{c\bar {c}}}}{{(4380)}^{ + }}$ remains in question, as does the potential contribution to $\Lambda _{b}^{0} \to J{\kern 1pt} /{\kern 1pt} \psi p{{K}^{ - }}$ decays from the strange tetraquark states ${{T}_{{c\bar {c}\bar {s}1}}}$(4000) and ${{T}_{{c\bar {c}\bar {s}1}}}$(4220). This paper presents a review of modern experimental results, the general methodology for analyzing $\Lambda _{b}^{0} \to J{\kern 1pt} /{\kern 1pt} \psi p{{K}^{ - }}$ decays at the ATLAS setup, and discusses the prospects for further experimental studies of pentaquark states in $pp$ collision data with a center-of-mass energy of $\sqrt s = 13$ TeV.
